decision.x-ace-constraint: Reject answers the gate, never bypasses it. plan: the plan is dropped and the planner drafts another. merge, escalation and destructive gates on a card: that card is declined (its lanes stop, it never merges, its dependants never start) and the rest of the run continues. budget, deadline and any gate not about a card: the run is cancelled. A budget approval needs a larger budget; a deadline approval needs a future deadline.
